title: chrysanthemum alpicola
intro: Chrysanthemum alpicola, commonly known as the alpine chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and promoting digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe the nervous system, calm the mind, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum alpicola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
